### Approach
The key insight is that a string can be rearranged into a palindrome if and only if the following conditions are met:
1. If the string length is even, all characters must appear an even number of times.
2. If the string length is odd, exactly one character can appear an odd number of times (which will be the middle character in the palindrome).

To efficiently check these conditions, we can do the following:

```python
    if not s:
        return True  # empty string is a palindrome

            odd_count += 1
    
    length = len(s)
    return (length % 2 == 0 and odd_count == 0) or (length % 2 == 1 and odd_count == 1)
```
